title: Refined eitr

# Refined eitr

Type: Material | Internal ID: Eitr | Source: Eitr refinery | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Sap x1, Soft tissue x1

# Introduction

Refined eitr is a crafting material obtained from the Eitr refinery. It is used for crafting and upgrading numerous Mistlands-tier items.

## Availability

• Produced in Eitr refinery

## Notes

• When thrown onto the ground, Refined eitr will emit occasional sparks that deal 30 poison and 30 lightning damage in the same way that the Eitr refinery does while it is in operation. These sparks can damage anything NOT immune to those types of damage, including creatures and other structures.
• After acquiring some, the player can drop several Refined eitr near Dvergr component crates for the resulting sparks to destroy them and claim more extractors. This process will not anger the nearby Dvergr, even if a Ward is present. Alternatively, it can be used to destroy the Ward itself and then manually attack the crate.

Categorias: Materials
